**New to Sonder Editor?** Start with the **Start here** and **Prepare your media** notes in **[LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_edit_vfx.json)**. They introduce importing media, timeline prompts, selecting a range, Guides and Drivers. You can read them without running a generation.

This workflow adds **References**, **character swaps** and **head swaps**. Choose a **Task** above, then follow the matching note below. Open **H3 setup** before your first run.

To refine or enlarge a finished result afterward, use **[LTX 2.5 Refine & Upscale](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_refine_upscale.json)**.", "group": "", "order": 9}, "h3_setup": {"text": "**H3 setup**

**Install the required nodes.** Use **Extensions → ComfyUI Manager** at the top right of ComfyUI to install [Sonder Editor](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor), [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) and [RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF). Restart ComfyUI and refresh the page afterward. Keep ComfyUI updated for its built-in H3, SAM3 and LoRA-list nodes.

**Set the H3 format.** In the toolbar above the timeline, choose **Model → MiniMax H3** and **Channels → MiniMax H3 (full reference)**. Use the choice with **(full reference)** for References.

**Load the models.** Open **Models and downloads** below. If **advanced hidden** appears below Modes, click it. Expand **Models and LoRAs** to select your installed files.

**Choose how much to change.** Under **Generation Settings**, set **Change Strength (Denoise)** to **1** for new content. Lower values rework the footage already on the timeline; compare a short test before processing a longer section.

**Keep the first test simple.** Above the timeline, use **Ctx: Pre/Post 0** and **Mask −/+ 0**. For editing, select a short range inside your footage. When adding context later, keep that range over real footage and sound: empty context supplies black pictures and silence.

**Run the selected section.** Set **[In / Out](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/generating.md#ways-to-set-in-and-out)** inside your footage. Open **Render Queue** at the bottom of Assets and turn **Queue Active** off. In ComfyUI, click **✕ Exit** at the upper right, then **Run**. In **[Sonder App](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/sonder-app.md#generate)**, click **Generate** with **×1** selected.", "group": "", "order": 10}, "h3_models": {"text": "**Models and downloads**

Click a filename to open its download page. Put it in the folder shown inside **ComfyUI/models/**.

- **Main model:** [minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors) → **diffusion_models/**
- **Text encoder:** [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_int8_convrot.safetensors) → **text_encoders/**
- **Video VAE:** [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors) → **vae/H3/**
- **Audio VAE:** [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors) → **vae/H3/**
- **Turbo LoRA:** [minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_DMAD_4step_full_lora_avg_rank_39_bf16.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Head swaps:** [minimax_h3_head_swap_v1.0_r32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video/blob/main/h3/minimax_h3_head_swap_v1.0_r32.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Character swaps:** [minimax_h3_character_swap_v1.1_ref2va_fro.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Alissonerdx/Minimax-H3-ComfyUI/blob/main/loras/minimax_h3_character_swap_v1.1_ref2va_fro.safetensors) → **loras/H3/**
- **Masked swaps:** [sam3.1_multiplex_int8_convrot_selective_fp16clip_fp32source.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Sparknight/sam3.1-int8-int4-convrot/blob/main/sam3.1_multiplex_int8_convrot_selective_fp16clip_fp32source.safetensors) → **checkpoints/**
- **Sampling preview:** [taeh3.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-TAE/blob/main/vae_approx/taeh3.safetensors) → **vae_approx/**

The swap LoRA is needed for its matching Task; SAM3 is used by the two masked swaps. **Additional LoRAs** is optional.

- **Use models from other folders.** If **advanced hidden** appears below Modes, click it. Expand **Models and LoRAs** and select your installed files in the matching model and LoRA controls.", "group": "", "order": 11}, "h3_references": {"text": "**Use References**

**[References](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md)** supply a character's appearance, a place, a visual example or a sound. They guide generation without becoming visible Video clips. Use this note for the three generation Tasks; swap Tasks use the picture setup here and the next note.

1. **Register your media.** In **References** at the upper left, click **+**, fill **Name**, then **Save**. Expand the new Reference, click **+ Member**, choose **Image**, **Video** or **Audio**, and select its asset. Fill **Member name** and **Prompt**, then **Save**. Use **Prompt** to describe what that member shows or contains.
2. **Place it in time.** Drag the member from **References** onto the timeline ruler, or click **Add to timeline** on its Reference card to stage the card's members at the playhead. Move or trim its Reference item to cover the section where it should apply. Adding media to the Library alone does not send it to the model.
3. **Choose how H3 receives it.** Click **☰** on the Reference lane header to open **Reference Lane Setup**. Under **Recipe → Template**, choose **MiniMax H3 Pictures**, **MiniMax H3 Videos (IMAGE sequences)** or **MiniMax H3 Standalone Audio** for the media you added. Keep different media types on separate Reference lanes.
4. **Choose the lanes this workflow reads.** Defaults: **R1: pictures · R2: videos · R3: audio**. Only change these selectors if you use different lanes. To change them, in **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if it appears, expand **Generation References**, then set **Picture Reference Lanes**, **Video Reference Lanes** and **Audio Reference Lanes** to your lanes. The graph accepts up to **9 pictures, 3 videos and 3 standalone audio** inputs.
5. **Use it in the prompt.** For generation Tasks, describe the action in a timeline **Prompt** section. Open **Prompt Management** from **☰** on the Prompt lane, then click **+ Attach → Reference** to attach the source you use. Follow **[H3 Subject or Picture setup](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#minimax-h3-full-reference)** for a character's identity, its appearance and what should carry over.

After choosing **In / Out**, check that the intended Reference item reads **In window**. See **[Reference timing](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/references.md#what-a-generation-window-resolves-to)** if it is excluded. This graph reads video References as pictures over time; use the standalone Audio Reference input for reference sound.", "group": "", "order": 12}, "h3_swaps": {"text": "**Swap a character or head**

1. **Keep the source picture and sound.** Place the original footage on a **Video** lane and its soundtrack on an **Audio** lane. Keep one copy of the sound. **[Dropping media on the timeline](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#dropping-assets-onto-the-timeline)** explains how to place picture and sound together.
2. **Add the source Driver.** Place a second copy of the video on another **Video** lane, right-click that clip and choose **Convert to Driver**. Keep its start, trim, length and framing matched to the original. The **[Driver](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/editor-basics.md#driver-clips)** supplies the performance used by the swap; it disappears from the normal preview.
3. **Add the replacement picture.** Follow **Use References** above with one picture on a **MiniMax H3 Pictures** lane. Keep it as the first member and cover the range you want to process. In the Library member's **Prompt**, describe the replacement's appearance. For a character swap, include clothing and body details; for a head swap, describe the head, face and hair.
4. **Choose the swap inputs.** Defaults: **D1: source video · R1: replacement picture**. Only change these selectors if you use different lanes. To change them, in **Controls**, click **advanced hidden** if it appears, expand **Swap Sources**, then set **Replacement Picture Lane** and **Source Driver Lane** to the matching lanes.
5. **Choose the change.** Under **Modes → Task**, select **Character Swap** or **Head Swap**. For a masked version, follow **Focus a swap with a mask** below. Swapping keeps your original audio.

**The swap prompt is prepared for you.** These Tasks use the first picture member's **Prompt** to describe the replacement. The timeline Prompt is ignored.

**Keep the source visible.** This is essential for masked swaps: the Video clip supplies the picture outside the mask, while the Driver supplies the swap guidance. Check a short section inside both clips first.", "group": "", "order": 13}, "h3_masked_swaps": {"text": "**Focus a swap with a mask**

**Prepare the swap first.** Follow **Swap a character or head** above. Keep matching copies on **Video and Driver** lanes; an empty Video area would leave the picture outside the mask black. This workflow makes the mask automatically—you do not need to import a mask video.

1. **Choose the masked Task.** Under **Modes → Task**, select **Masked Character Swap** or **Masked Head Swap**.
2. **Describe who changes.** In **Controls**, use **Who do you want to mask and swap in your target video?** below Modes. Describe the target, such as `the woman`. For a head-only area, describe that person's head.
3. **Check the processed guide.** Open the source menu at the top of a viewport pane, choose **Masked Driver Preview**, then click that pane's **Run**. It shows the Driver prepared for the swap, with the surrounding area blacked out. Check that the intended person or head is included before running the full generation.
4. **Adjust the edges if needed.** Expand **Mask Settings** in Controls. **Grow / Shrink Mask** grows the affected area; **Mask Edge Softness** softens its edge. Preview again after changing them.
", "group": "", "order": 14}, "h3_review": {"text": "**Review and continue**

**Find your result.** Open **Assets → Takes** at the upper left. With **Controls → Editor → Save as → Take**, the result is also placed on the timeline. **Video** saves it in Assets without placing it.

**Keep sound with the result.** Saved swap videos include the existing timeline audio. 

**Save for the next pass.** In **Controls → Editor → Output Format**, choose **Lossless FFV1 (RGB)** or **Editing Master MP4** when you plan more editing or another workflow. Use **High Quality MP4** for a finished video. Lossless files can be much larger.

**Refine or enlarge it.** Open **[LTX 2.5 Refine & Upscale](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_refine_upscale.json)** and use the scene or saved result you want to process. It can refine at the timeline resolution, enlarge to twice the timeline's width and height, or do both.

For choosing between versions, see **[Compare](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/docs/assets-and-gallery.md#compare-mode)**. The **Review and export** note in **[LTX 2.5 Edit & VFX](https://github.com/SonderSaid/ComfyUI-Sonder-Editor/blob/main/example_workflows/sonder_ltx_2_5_edit_vfx.json)** covers the shared review and export steps.", "group": "", "order": 15}}, "groups": {"Generation Settings": {"order": 0}, "Mask Settings": {"order": 1}, "Models and LoRAs": {"order": 2}, "Generation References": {"order": 3}, "Swap Sources": {"order": 4}, "Processing Switches": {"order": 5}}, "description": "## MiniMax H3

retention_analysis:

<Subject 1> (appears throughout the target video): attribute_transfer - the complete head identity from <Picture 1>, including facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, head shape, proportions, skin appearance, and distinctive features, is transferred consistently onto the body of <Subject 2>.

<Subject 2> (appears throughout the target video): partially_preserved - the original body, neck position, clothing, pose, motion, gestures, actions, and physical performance are preserved, while only the original head is replaced.

<Video 1> (entire target timeline): partially_preserved - the original video timing, body motion, camera movement, framing, lighting, background, environment, scene composition, and temporal structure are preserved; only the subject's head appearance is modified.

detailed_description:

Preserve <Video 1> as the complete temporal and compositional foundation of the target video. <Subject 2> retains the exact original body, clothing, pose, body proportions, movement, gestures, actions, speed, timing, and interaction with the environment.

Replace only the entire original head of <Subject 2> with <Subject 1>, the reference head identity from <Picture 1>. Preserve the complete recognizable identity of <Subject 1>, including facial structure, skull and head shape, hairstyle, hairline, skin appearance, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, jawline, ears, and distinctive identifying features.

The transferred head follows the original head motion and performance of <Subject 2> throughout <Video 1>, including head rotation, tilt, pitch, yaw, natural translation, facial orientation, gaze direction, and perspective changes. Maintain anatomically correct head scale and a seamless connection between the transferred head and the original neck.

Preserve the lighting conditions of <Video 1> on the transferred head. The head naturally responds to changes in illumination, shadows, highlights, color temperature, exposure, depth of field, motion blur, occlusion, camera angle, and perspective while continuously maintaining the identity established by <Picture 1>.

Maintain strong temporal consistency across every frame. The identity, facial geometry, hairstyle, head size, skin appearance, and distinguishing features of <Subject 1> remain stable during motion and viewpoint changes. Prevent identity drift, facial morphing, hairstyle changes, head-size fluctuations, geometry instability, texture crawling, temporal flickering, frame-to-frame inconsistency, or sudden changes in facial appearance.
